criteria.unit: One forecast per game, market, player and line from the last snapshot saved before tipoff; model and market probabilities are conditional on no push; pushes and voids are left out.
criteria.market: Average of each paired book's no-vig probability at that line (one vote per book).
criteria.main_line: The line the most books pair for that player and market (ties: nearest the median).
criteria.movement: Consensus change between the last two pregame snapshots (within 36 hours) in the direction of the earlier model lean, where the lean was at least 3%.
criteria.readiness: Proposed, not automatic: at least 150 graded games, the 10% blend beating the market on log loss with the whole 95% interval below zero, and the market moving toward the model with the whole interval above zero.
criteria.intervals: 95% percentile intervals from 1000 bootstrap replicates over games, shown once at least 10 games are in the sample.
